claims.statement: Clipping and harmonic distortion are both closed by sufficient Evidence; the supported cause set is empty.
Harmonic distortion is affirmatively supported by valid harmonic evidence with a reportable order-2 component; the THD rule is FAIL, consistent with elevated harmonic content.
Clipping is absent and harmonic distortion is within acceptable limits; the supported cause set is empty.
Clipping is affirmatively supported by same-run Evidence: flat-top clipping detected with clipping ratio above the configured threshold.
A reportable even-order (order-2) component supports an independent harmonic_distortion claim; THD is elevated and the configured rule is FAIL.

limitations: THD rule FAIL establishes elevated harmonic content relative to the configured threshold, not causal harmonic_distortion without additional distortion-mechanism Evidence.

claims.statement: Harmonic measurement is valid and the THD rule is FAIL, but no same-run Evidence establishes a causal S1 distortion mechanism.
